\textbf{Source.} Tadelis (2013), \emph{Game Theory: An Introduction}, Exercise 6.8 ``Market Entry'', p.~125 {[}PDF p.~144{]}. Answer in the source: none (the preface, p.~xiii, says about half of the exercises are solved on Princeton UP's website). Reproduced verbatim.

\begin{quote}
\textbf{Market Entry:} Three firms are considering entering a new market. The payoff for each firm that enters is \(\frac{150}{n}\), where \(n\) is the number of firms that enter. The cost of entering is 62.

\begin{enumerate}
\def\labelenumi{\alph{enumi}.}
\item
  Find all the pure-strategy Nash equilibria.
\item
  Find the symmetric mixed-strategy equilibrium in which all three players enter with the same probability.
\end{enumerate}
\end{quote}
